hits.title: PhotoShelter Announces New CEO: Andrew Fingerman
hits.snippet: **Media Contact** Deborah Block PhotoShelter 212-206-0808 x3325 deborah [at] photoshelter [dot] com # PhotoShelter Announces New CEO: Andrew Fingerman ## Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi shifts to Chairman of the Board **New York, NY, May 2, 2012** \- PhotoShelter ( <http://www.photoshelter.com> ), PhotoShelter, the leader in photography portfolio websites, sales, marketing and archiving tools announced today that Andrew Fingerman will be named the company’s new Chief Executive Officer. Andrew replaces PhotoShelter Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi who has led the company as CEO since its inception in 2005. Murabayashi will be moving to the Chairman of the Board role, focusing on strategic vision and an intensive schedule of photographer events and PhotoShelter speaking engagements. Fingerman has served as PhotoShelter’s Vice President of Marketing for 4.5 years.
